info.description: An editorial overlay for a room in packages/campus-map. roomKey, editorLabel and catalogActive are maintained by 'pnpm --filter @campus/cms rooms:sync'. Display names, descriptions, visibility and contact relations are maintained here and never touched by the sync.

editorLabel.description: CATALOGUE — human readable label used in relation pickers.

roomKey.description: CATALOGUE — stable technical identifier. Never edit; the map catalogue owns it.

catalogActive.description: CATALOGUE — false once the room disappeared from the catalogue. The sync deactivates rather than deletes, so editorial work is never lost.

displayNameDe.description: EDITORIAL — optional German display name shown instead of the bare room number.

isVisible.description: EDITORIAL — hide a room from the public API without touching the catalogue.
